item.title: Arch Linux disables AUR package adoption
item.description:
📝 The Arch Linux DevOps team has announced that adoption of orphaned packages in the Arch User Repository (AUR) has been disabled due to "the current influx of malicious package adoptions and follow-up commits made via the AUR". That followed a campaign in which an attacker or attackers created new accounts to adopt orphaned packages and push malicious updates to them that would install malware on user systems. Even if all that is accomplished is bots learning to slow down, I think that could be seen as at least a minor (perhaps merely trivial.
🔗 Read more: https://lwn.net/Articles/1086489/
